shape.text: Netlify's announcement of 2023-11-07 states that every Netlify authentication token starts with nf followed by one identifying character, nfp for a personal access token, and tells customers to allow 40 characters of storage. The underscore after nfp and the body alphabet are not written on the page.
Two scanner rules agree on nfp_ followed by 36 characters from letters, digits and underscore, 40 characters in all.
Netlify's API guide documents only creating a token and sending it as a Bearer header.

collisions.text: The other four nf classes (nfc, nfo, nfu, nfb, for CLI, OAuth, app and build tokens) share the scheme and length but are different credentials.
Tokens issued before 2023 share one unprefixed shape across all five classes, so that form cannot be labelled as a personal token. Site, account and deploy ids and preview URLs are not credentials.
